videos.title: October 2, 2019
videos.overview: Universal Champion Seth Rollins is the debut in-studio guest on WWE's The Bump.

videos.title: October 9, 2019
videos.overview: WWE Hall of Famer D-Von Dudley joins the crew in-studio for a Mock Draft special, and Tommaso Ciampa calls into WWE's The Bump to talk about his return to NXT.

videos.title: October 16, 2019
videos.overview: Raw Women's Champion Becky Lynch calls in to WWE's The Bump with her thoughts on being the first pick in the 2019 WWE Draft and fellow first-round pick Drew McIntyre stops by the studio to catch up the entire WWE Universe on what he has in store for the red brand.

videos.title: October 23, 2019
videos.overview: R-Truth and Drake Maverick buried the hatchet and both Carmella and Heath Slater called in on an unforgettable episode of WWE's The Bump.

videos.title: October 30, 2019
videos.overview: Matt Hardy joins WWE's The Bump for a special Halloween episode and Tegan Nox and Dakota Kai call in to talk about their ascent in NXT.
